---
title: "Module 08: Spatial cluster differential expression analysis"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-11"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 08 — Spatial cluster differential expression analysis
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Identify genes enriched or depleted across Harmony-derived spatial
#   clusters, summarize significant differential expression, visualize
#   cluster markers, and examine Prkcd expression across the spatial dataset.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds
#
# Outputs:
#   results/spatial/cluster_dea/
#   figures/spatial/cluster_dea/
#
# Differential expression:
#   Assay:                       SCT
#   Identity:                    spatial_cluster
#   Test:                        Wilcoxon rank-sum test
#   Minimum detection fraction: 0.10
#   Testing log2FC threshold:    0.25
#
# Significant DEG definition:
#   adjusted P < 0.05
#   |average log2FC| > 0.58
#
# Notes:
#   - Each cluster is compared against all remaining spatial spots.
#   - 0.58 log2FC corresponds approximately to a 1.5-fold difference.
#   - Raw Spatial counts are not modified.
#   - Malignant versus non-malignant DEA is performed after inferCNV.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis parameters

dea_assay <- "SCT"

cluster_column <- "spatial_cluster"

marker_test <- "wilcox"
marker_min_pct <- 0.10
marker_test_log2fc_threshold <- 0.25

significant_log2fc_threshold <- 0.58
adjusted_p_threshold <- 0.05

top_markers_per_cluster <- 10
volcano_labels_per_cluster <- 10

gene_of_interest <- "Prkcd"


# Repository paths

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "cluster_dea"
)

cluster_table_directory <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "cluster_tables"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "cluster_dea"
)

volcano_directory <- file.path(
  figure_directory,
  "volcano_plots"
)


for (directory in c(
  results_directory,
  cluster_table_directory,
  figure_directory,
  volcano_directory
)) {

  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load and prepare spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {

  stop(
    "Module 07 output not found: ",
    input_file
  )
}


message(
  "Loading processed spatial object..."
)


spatial_object <- readRDS(
  input_file
)


if (!dea_assay %in% Seurat::Assays(spatial_object)) {

  stop(
    "Required assay not found: ",
    dea_assay
  )
}


if (!cluster_column %in% colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)) {

  stop(
    "Required cluster metadata not found: ",
    cluster_column
  )
}


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_object
) <- dea_assay


Seurat::Idents(
  spatial_object
) <- cluster_column


cluster_ids <- levels(
  Seurat::Idents(
    spatial_object
  )
)


if (length(cluster_ids) < 2) {

  stop(
    "At least two spatial clusters are required for differential expression."
  )
}


message(
  "Loaded ",
  ncol(spatial_object),
  " spots across ",
  length(cluster_ids),
  " spatial clusters."
)


print(
  table(
    Seurat::Idents(
      spatial_object
    )
  )
)


# Join multiple SCT data layers if present.

sct_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_object[[dea_assay]]
)


if (sum(grepl("^data", sct_layers)) > 1) {

  message(
    "Joining SCT data layers..."
  )

  spatial_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_object,
    assay = dea_assay
  )
}


# Prepare merged SCT models for differential expression when required.

sct_model_count <- 0


if ("SCTModel.list" %in% slotNames(spatial_object[[dea_assay]])) {

  sct_model_count <- length(
    spatial_object[[dea_assay]]@SCTModel.list
  )
}


if (sct_model_count > 1) {

  message(
    "Preparing multiple SCT models for differential expression..."
  )

  spatial_object <- Seurat::PrepSCTFindMarkers(
    object = spatial_object,
    assay = dea_assay,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}


# Record analysis parameters.

dea_parameters <- data.frame(

  parameter = c(
    "assay",
    "cluster_identity",
    "test",
    "minimum_detection_fraction",
    "FindAllMarkers_log2FC_threshold",
    "significant_log2FC_threshold",
    "adjusted_P_threshold",
    "top_markers_per_cluster"
  ),

  value = c(
    dea_assay,
    cluster_column,
    marker_test,
    marker_min_pct,
    marker_test_log2fc_threshold,
    significant_log2fc_threshold,
    adjusted_p_threshold,
    top_markers_per_cluster
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


utils::write.csv(
  dea_parameters,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_DEA_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Differential expression across spatial clusters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Running differential expression across spatial clusters..."
)


cluster_markers <- Seurat::FindAllMarkers(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = dea_assay,
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.pct = marker_min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = marker_test_log2fc_threshold,
  test.use = marker_test,
  verbose = FALSE
)


if (nrow(cluster_markers) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No spatial cluster marker genes were identified."
  )
}


# Ensure gene symbols are stored explicitly.

if (!"gene" %in% colnames(cluster_markers)) {

  cluster_markers$gene <- rownames(
    cluster_markers
  )
}


cluster_markers$gene <- as.character(
  cluster_markers$gene
)


# Classify results using the reporting thresholds.

cluster_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    significance = dplyr::case_when(

      p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
        avg_log2FC > significant_log2fc_threshold ~
        "Upregulated",

      p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
        avg_log2FC < -significant_log2fc_threshold ~
        "Downregulated",

      TRUE ~
        "Not significant"
    )
  )


significant_cluster_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance != "Not significant"
  )


significant_positive_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance == "Upregulated"
  )


significant_negative_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance == "Downregulated"
  )


message(
  "DEA complete: ",
  nrow(significant_cluster_markers),
  " significant results (",
  nrow(significant_positive_markers),
  " up; ",
  nrow(significant_negative_markers),
  " down)."
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Export and summarize DEG results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

utils::write.csv(
  cluster_markers,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_markers_all.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


utils::write.csv(
  significant_cluster_markers,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_markers_significant.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


utils::write.csv(
  significant_positive_markers,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_markers_upregulated.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


utils::write.csv(
  significant_negative_markers,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_markers_downregulated.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Summarize significant genes per cluster.

marker_summary <- cluster_markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    tested_markers = dplyr::n(),

    significant_markers = sum(
      significance != "Not significant"
    ),

    upregulated_markers = sum(
      significance == "Upregulated"
    ),

    downregulated_markers = sum(
      significance == "Downregulated"
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(
  marker_summary
)


utils::write.csv(
  marker_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_marker_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Save significant DEG tables for individual clusters.

for (cluster_id in cluster_ids) {

  cluster_results <- significant_cluster_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(cluster) == cluster_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p_val_adj,
      dplyr::desc(
        abs(avg_log2FC)
      )
    )


  utils::write.csv(
    cluster_results,
    file.path(
      cluster_table_directory,
      paste0(
        "spatial_cluster_",
        cluster_id,
        "_significant_DEGs.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Identify and visualize top cluster markers
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

top_positive_markers <- significant_positive_markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = avg_log2FC,
    n = top_markers_per_cluster,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


if (nrow(top_positive_markers) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No significant positive markers were available for heatmap generation."
  )
}


utils::write.csv(
  top_positive_markers,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_top10_positive_markers.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


heatmap_genes <- unique(
  top_positive_markers$gene
)


heatmap_genes <- intersect(
  heatmap_genes,
  rownames(spatial_object)
)


if (length(heatmap_genes) == 0) {

  stop(
    "Selected marker genes were not found in the spatial object."
  )
}


# Scale only the selected marker genes for visualization.

spatial_object <- Seurat::ScaleData(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = dea_assay,
  features = heatmap_genes,
  verbose = FALSE
)


cluster_heatmap <- Seurat::DoHeatmap(
  object = spatial_object,
  features = heatmap_genes,
  group.by = cluster_column,
  size = 3
) +
  Seurat::NoLegend()


print(
  cluster_heatmap
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_top10_marker_heatmap.png"
  ),
  plot = cluster_heatmap,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Generate cluster volcano plots
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Generating cluster volcano plots..."
)


for (cluster_id in cluster_ids) {

  cluster_de <- cluster_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(cluster) == cluster_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      plot_p = pmax(
        p_val_adj,
        .Machine$double.xmin
      ),

      neg_log10_p = -log10(
        plot_p
      )
    )


  # Label the strongest positive markers for readability.

  volcano_labels <- cluster_de %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      significance == "Upregulated"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(
      order_by = avg_log2FC,
      n = volcano_labels_per_cluster,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )


  volcano_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    cluster_de,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = avg_log2FC,
      y = neg_log10_p
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(
        color = significance
      ),
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.6
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(
        -significant_log2fc_threshold,
        significant_log2fc_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(
        adjusted_p_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = volcano_labels,
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = gene
      ),
      size = 3.2,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
        "Downregulated" = "#4575B4",
        "Not significant" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Spatial Cluster ",
        cluster_id
      ),
      subtitle = "Cluster compared with all remaining spatial spots",
      x = "Average log2 fold change",
      y = expression(
        -log[10]("adjusted p-value")
      ),
      color = NULL
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "top"
    )


  # Display each volcano interactively.

  print(
    volcano_plot
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      volcano_directory,
      paste0(
        "spatial_cluster_",
        cluster_id,
        "_volcano.png"
      )
    ),
    plot = volcano_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Examine Prkcd expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (gene_of_interest %in% rownames(spatial_object)) {

  # Differential-expression results for Prkcd.

  prkcd_marker_results <- cluster_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      gene == gene_of_interest
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p_val_adj
    )


  print(
    prkcd_marker_results
  )


  utils::write.csv(
    prkcd_marker_results,
    file.path(
      results_directory,
      "spatial_Prkcd_cluster_DEA.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # UMAP expression.

  prkcd_umap <- Seurat::FeaturePlot(
    spatial_object,
    features = gene_of_interest,
    reduction = "umap"
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Prkcd Expression Across Spatial UMAP"
    )


  print(
    prkcd_umap
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      figure_directory,
      "spatial_Prkcd_UMAP.png"
    ),
    plot = prkcd_umap,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )


  # Expression across spatial clusters.

  prkcd_violin <- Seurat::VlnPlot(
    spatial_object,
    features = gene_of_interest,
    group.by = cluster_column,
    pt.size = 0
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Prkcd Expression Across Spatial Clusters",
      x = "Spatial cluster",
      y = "Expression"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    )


  print(
    prkcd_violin
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      figure_directory,
      "spatial_Prkcd_violin_by_cluster.png"
    ),
    plot = prkcd_violin,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )


  # Spatial expression across the four tissue sections.

  spatial_images <- c(
    "Naive_A9",
    "Niacin2_B5",
    "Vehicle1_C5",
    "Vehicle2_D5"
  )


  spatial_titles <- c(
    "Normal tissue",
    "Niacin treatment",
    "Vehicle 1",
    "Vehicle 2"
  )


  prkcd_spatial_plots <- lapply(
    seq_along(spatial_images),
    function(i) {

      Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
        spatial_object,
        features = gene_of_interest,
        images = spatial_images[i]
      ) +
        ggplot2::labs(
          title = spatial_titles[i]
        )
    }
  )


  # Display the individual tissue sections.

  for (plot_object in prkcd_spatial_plots) {

    print(
      plot_object
    )
  }


  # Combine the four tissue sections for comparison.

  prkcd_spatial_overview <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    prkcd_spatial_plots,
    nrow = 1
  )


  print(
    prkcd_spatial_overview
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      figure_directory,
      "spatial_Prkcd_all_slides.png"
    ),
    plot = prkcd_spatial_overview,
    width = 20,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 600
  )


} else {

  warning(
    gene_of_interest,
    " was not found in the spatial object."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Complete module
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Module 08 complete: ",
  length(cluster_ids),
  " clusters; ",
  nrow(cluster_markers),
  " marker results; ",
  nrow(significant_cluster_markers),
  " significant DEGs."
)
```
